_verify: One topic per screen. Every number comes from the UVU 2024–2025 Annual Report or the EverGREEN Campaign Report (see _source). Add new numbers only from those reports. Donor gifts are from the EverGREEN report; confirm donors are comfortable being named on public signage.
headline: Thank You to Our Donors

photo.alt: UVU’s Orem campus below Mount Timpanogos

items.label: Rich and Marla Linder
items.text: A $35 million gift, the largest in UVU history, for a health and wellness building on the Vineyard Campus and the Orrin G. Hatch Center for National Security Studies.

items.label: Utah Community Credit Union
items.text: A $28.5 million pledge that helped build UCCU Stadium, home of UVU soccer.

items.label: Scott and Karen Smith
items.text: A $25 million gift that built the Scott M. Smith Engineering Building for more than 6,500 students.

items.label: The Kahlert Foundation
items.text: A $5.2 million gift to establish the Kahlert Applied Artificial Intelligence Institute.

items.label: Chelsea and Casey Baugh
items.text: A $5 million gift to the Chelsea and Casey Baugh Entrepreneurship Institute, which serves more than 4,500 students.
items._source: UVU 2024–2025 Annual Report, p. 37; EverGREEN Campaign Report (v8), p. 19
